scope: Exact original application instructions with explicit intercepted CCL string provider semantics; no original Core/libc instruction execution. Compiled pinned CCL comparison is performed by separate replay.py, never used to generate expected observations. Outputs and guard bytes checked; uninitialized unused string-tail bytes excluded. All integer boundaries including ARM32 addition wrap, null/empty/long default string. Private emulator memory only, no syscalls/network/devices. Isolated canonical source changes; not integration/readiness/ARM ABI proof.
